doc: A tree's geometry before colour: the mesh with its skinning and paint regions, plus the skeleton the animator needs.

fields.name: spec
fields.doc: The request, passed through for colouring.

fields.name: footprint_radius
fields.doc: Radius of the ground contact of this species at its largest age, metres: what its footprint must hold (design/plotter.md, Footprints and conformance).

fields.name: footprint_cells
fields.doc: The footprint on the hex grid at the largest age: 1 (single), 7 (flower7), 19 (flower19), or 37 cells.

fields.name: bone_b
fields.doc: Second bone per vertex (smooth bends along a branch).

fields.name: bone_w
fields.doc: Weight of bone_b per vertex (0 = all bone_a).

fields.name: region
fields.doc: Paint region per vertex: 0 bark, 1 wood (cut faces), 2 leaf, 3 blossom, 4 fruit, 5 dead leaf, 6 dead wood, 7 hanging moss.

fields.name: shade
fields.doc: Per-vertex variation in [0, 1]: bark relief (0 furrow, 1 ridge) or a clump's random tint.

fields.name: up
fields.doc: How much the surface faces up and is exposed, in [0, 1]: where snow and moss settle.

fields.name: collision
fields.doc: What collides (design/spine.md, Layer 1): static for the build, inside the conformance.
